overview: Rift Delver is a 3D expedition shooter through a lost machine city, built around drafting circuits and choosing when to bank salvage. Three encounters make a depth, with a Warden encounter every third depth, rotating environments and increasing difficulty. Extraction funds a permanent four-track workshop and deeper clears unlock additional weapons.
rules: After each encounter choose one of three seeded circuits and recover some hull; circuits stack and change weapon or survival behavior.
Three encounters clear a depth and open the choice to extract or descend. Every third depth ends with a Warden and escort.
Extract to bank salvage. Defeat retains 25% of unbanked salvage plus Insurance upgrades.
Firing creates heat; manage bursts and cooling. Dash briefly protects, while shockwave damages/slows nearby enemies and clears projectiles.
Depth three unlocks Shard Caster; depth six unlocks Arc Lance; workshop tracks have ten ranks each.
controls: WASD/left stick moves; mouse/right stick aims; left mouse/right trigger fires.
Right mouse/RB shockwave; Shift/LB dash; Space/A jump; Q/X cycles weapons.
E/Enter starts/descends/returns; 1–3 drafts circuits; at extraction 1 banks and 2 descends; 1–4 buys workshop ranks.
F5/F9 quick-save/load; Escape pause/settings; F fullscreen.
story: The player descends through a lost machine city to salvage its technology. The documented progression is expeditions and workshop upgrades; no dialogue campaign is described.

characters.name: Flying drones
characters.description: Airborne machines that hover above the floor, fire aimed projectiles and back away when the player approaches.

characters.name: Melee machines
characters.description: Charging close-range machines that commit to a direction before rushing; their pauses create room to sidestep.

characters.name: Brutes
characters.description: Heavy, slow-moving machines with more hull than ordinary attackers and stronger contact damage.

characters.name: Sentinels
characters.description: Ranged machines that fire aimed projectiles when they have a clear shot and retreat from a nearby player.

characters.name: Wardens
characters.description: Boss machines encountered every third depth. They launch radial projectile rings and an aimed shot, supported by escorts.

design.original_prompt: Using the latest BlueEngine, make a high quality 3d game that can be played for hours. I love time sink games so try to make it something that a player can really get invested in. Ensure the gameplay itself and the game mechanics are the core of the gaming experience. Ensure the game feels incredible to play. Once it is done, please publish to BlueEngineGames and create high quality feedback for the BlueEngine project to improve
